# Ahmadreza Taheri (احمدرضا طاهری)

<!-- CONTENT-TODO CR-1049: placeholder summary for AI crawlers, written from facts the site already states. Review with the owner. -->

> Ahmadreza Taheri is an IT specialist in training for system integration (German: "Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration in Ausbildung") in Trier, Germany. His focus is networks and Linux. He works in German, English and Persian. ahmadreza.de is his portfolio: an interactive history of computing that teaches how computers work while introducing him.

## About the person

- Name: Ahmadreza Taheri; in Persian: احمدرضا طاهری
- Role: Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration in Ausbildung (IT specialist for system integration, apprentice)
- Location: Trier, Germany
- Focus: system integration, networks, Linux, IT support
- Languages: German, English, Persian
- Contact: ahmadrezataheride@gmail.com

## About the site

The site is called Amonel. It has three parts:

- The landing page, with who he is and how to reach him.
- The journey (Amonel): seven eras of computing - 1946 ENIAC, 1956 mainframes, 1971 UNIX, 1981 IBM PC and MS-DOS, 1984 Macintosh, 1995 Windows 95 and dial-up, and today's cloud - each with one lasting truth about computers and a small puzzle.
- The desktop (Amonel OS): a browser desktop with apps - About, a terminal, helpdesk tickets, traceroute, a local search assistant and a computer quiz.
